issues.description: The problem statement requires defining 'status_flag' as a single byte (problem_statement.md lines 21-22). In the solution repository, 'status_flag' is defined as a double word using 'dd' (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 4), which allocates 4 bytes. This is a direct type/size mismatch: the solution does not follow the explicit requirement in the problem text. Students following the specification will define a single-byte symbol (e.g., using 'db'), while the provided solution uses a 4-byte declaration. This can cause confusion about the correct size of the flag and may lead to grading or runtime differences if automated checks expect a single byte.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution match the problem specification by declaring 'status_flag' as a single byte. For example, replace 'status_flag dd 1' with 'status_flag db 1' in solution_repository/helloWorld.asm. Alternatively, if a 4-byte flag was intended, update the problem statement to explicitly require a 4-byte definition and explain why.
